days.title: Village Heritage and Lake Adventures
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Brunngasse
stops.detail: Brunngasse, with its cobblestones and its wooden chalets decorated with flowers and carvings, is a must-see.

stops.name: Lake Brienz
stops.detail: Discover Lake Brienz along with the Giessbach Falls and the Brienzer Rothorn.

stops.name: Giessbach Falls
stops.detail: The top excursion destination on Lake Brienz is the Giessbach Falls: you travel by boat from Brienz to Giessbach station, and from there you’ll take the nostalgic funicular up to the Grandhotel Giessbach.

days.title: Mountain Peaks and Woodcarving Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Brienzer Rothorn
stops.detail: Between June and October, experience a ride on the historic steam-powered cog railway to the Brienzer Rothorn.

stops.name: Schnitzlerweg
stops.detail: You can also marvel at the art of wood carving on the Schnitzlerweg woodcarving trail on the Axalp above Brienz.

stops.name: Hinterburgseeli
stops.detail: Perhaps with a detour to the enchanting Hinterburgseeli lake along the way.
